title: Player finds Enchiridion fragment

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Hey, did you find any fragments yet?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, did you find any fragments yet?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Fascinating. Looks like junk. But this scratch here, it might be the symbol for “up” and this one, some kind of numeral…?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fascinating. Looks like junk. But this scratch here, it might be the symbol for “up” and this one, some kind of numeral…?
What? Right, yes, thanks, thanks!

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: What? Oh yes, I did promise, didn't I? Alright, have you heard the story of the Macrogillean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What? Oh yes, I did promise, didn't I? Alright, have you heard the story of the Macrogillean?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Right! Well, legend has it that the Macrogillean is the largest fish ever seen in Nivalis waters.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right! Well, legend has it that the Macrogillean is the largest fish ever seen in Nivalis waters.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Who knows? But an old fisherman once told me a secret: that the Macrogillean can only be caught in the waters off the islands after dark.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who knows? But an old fisherman once told me a secret: that the Macrogillean can only be caught in the waters off the islands after dark.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Well, I know plenty of fishermen who would kill for that rumor. Or... maybe not "kill." Lightly maim.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I know plenty of fishermen who would kill for that rumor. Or... maybe not "kill." Lightly maim.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: There’s more where that came from.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There’s more where that came from.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Some say he’s an ancient carp who devoured his CEO owner and fled to the Sewers. Others say he’s a mutant trout, the product of bio-corp experimentation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Some say he’s an ancient carp who devoured his CEO owner and fled to the Sewers. Others say he’s a mutant trout, the product of bio-corp experimentation.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Some say he’s actually a shapeshifting droid who can take human form...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Some say he’s actually a shapeshifting droid who can take human form...

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Oh, I have to get this under a microscope…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, I have to get this under a microscope…
I did.
What about my secret?
I'll leave you to it.
You mean the giant fish?
Can't say I have.
What's the truth?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: All that work for a fishing rumor?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All that work for a fishing rumor?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: All that work for a fishing rumor?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: All that work for a fishing rumor?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll keep that in mind, thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll keep that in mind, thanks.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll keep that in mind, thanks.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll keep that in mind, thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks I guess.
What does it mean?
Maybe it IS junk?
Just folklore, right?
